# Sudabelt Medical Ltd.

> Advancing Healthcare Excellence in Africa — Integrated medical technology provider, turnkey hospital infrastructure partner, OEM-certified clinical applications trainer, and nationwide biomedical engineering support organization operating across Nigeria and West Africa.

- **Official Website:** https://www.sudabelt.com
- **Quality Certification:** ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- **Core Values:** Commitment · Accountability · Reliability · Efficiency (C.A.R.E.)

## Authorized Global OEM Partnerships (8 Partners)
Sudabelt Medical is an authorized distributor, installer, and biomedical service partner for 8 leading global medical device manufacturers:
1. **GE HealthCare** — Diagnostic Imaging (CT, MRI, Ultrasound, X-Ray), Patient Monitoring, Anesthesia & Maternal-Infant Care
2. **Baxter (Vantive)** — Hemodialysis (AK 98), Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (Baxter Vantive PrisMax, Baxter Vantive Prismaflex), Peritoneal Dialysis & Water Treatment
3. **Terumo BCT** — Therapeutic Apheresis (Spectra Optia), Automated Blood Collection (Trima Accel), Whole Blood Processing (Reveos) & Pathogen Reduction (Mirasol PRT)
4. **Abbott** — Clinical Chemistry, Immunoassay & Molecular Diagnostics (Alinity ci-Series, Alinity m, ARCHITECT i2000SR, i-STAT Alinity)
5. **SWS Medical** — Hemodialysis & Continuous Blood Purification Systems (SWS-6000A, SWS-5000)
6. **Maccura** — Hematology Analyzers (F Series: F560, F580, F600, F800, F810, F880), Chemiluminescence (i800, i1000) & Clinical Chemistry (C1000)
7. **Fisher & Paykel Healthcare** — Respiratory Humidification, Optiflow High Flow Therapy (AIRVO 2, F&P 950, MR850) & Neonatal Care (CosyCot)
8. **Ezisurg Medical** — Minimally Invasive Surgery (easyEndo Staplers, easyUS Ultrasonic Surgical System, enScope Digital Ureteroscopes & Video Processors)

## Turnkey Engineering & Core Services
- **Healthcare Technology Solutions & Medical Consumables:** Equipment supply, genuine local consumable buffer stock, and live demonstrations.
- **Healthcare Infrastructure & Turnkey Projects:** Hospital design, ICU/dialysis/diagnostic centre build-outs, medical gas & RO water loops, installation, and clinical commissioning. (https://www.sudabelt.com/services/turnkey | https://www.sudabelt.com/projects)
- **Biomedical Engineering Solutions:** Preventive & corrective maintenance, precision calibration, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and <24hr emergency response. (https://www.sudabelt.com/support)
- **Clinical Applications Training & Biomedical Engineering Support:** Hands-on operational training for physicians, nurses, and lab specialists plus technical repair/maintenance training for hospital biomedical engineers across all 8 OEM brands. (https://www.sudabelt.com/training-hub)
